snippet.title: Trailer PC CURSED 98 Magazine
snippet.description:
AVAILABLE 11 JAN 2024 ON #itchio 

Embark on a spine-chilling journey with PC Cursed 98! 🌙 Unveil the dark secrets lurking in our demo disc and magazine, featuring 21 terrifying indie games from the depths of itch.io. 🎮💿 Brace yourself for an immersive blend of horror and humor that will leave you trembling and laughing in equal measure. Subscribe now for a macabre adventure that transcends the ordinary! 😱🔮 #indiegame #IndieHorror #horrorgaming " #indiegames #horrorstories
